headline: Mooring County Leads as Linn Mercy Rekindles
war_summary: Since the last edition Mooring County remains the busiest wire with three changes in two hours and fifty-five in the day about The Wind Hills and Gravekeeper's Holdfast, now standing four Warden, eight Colonial with heavy twenty-four-hour losses of 18,561 Colonial and 16,478 Warden casualties. Linn Mercy has quickened to five changes in two hours and thirty-four in the day about Lathair and Outwich Ranch, holding one Warden, nine Colonial and one ruined. The Weathered Expanse has gone quiet in the last two hours after nine in six and thirty-seven in the day about Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance, now two Warden, three Colonial and four ruined. Callum's Cape reports one change in two hours and twenty-eight in the day about Ire and Lookout at two Warden to five Colonial, while Marban Hollow shows none in two hours and twelve in the day about Checkpoint Bua at four Warden, three Colonial and one ruined. Callahan's Passage and Deadlands report no changes despite continued casualties.
